workbench_contracts.why: Defines the shared graph-workbench DTO layer: surface, nodes, links, UI state, chrome, actions, chips, group frames, and typed callback payloads.

workbench_component.why: Reusable Blazor host for the shared workbench canvas, including toolbar chrome, maximize/focus/fit interactions, JS interop lifecycle, and typed callbacks.

workbench_stage.why: Shared shell used by Project Structure and Prompt Factory for eyebrow/title copy, stats, canvas slot, inspector slot, and supporting panels.

workbench_js.why: Main shared graph runtime. Owns normalization, DOM/SVG rendering, measurement, links, group frames, context menus, create composers, drag, marquee, zoom, pan, maximize, and exported JS interop surface.

workbench_css.why: Visual design system for the workbench host, node cards, inspector, context menus, overlays, and supporting panels.

calendar_contracts.why: Defines the typed wrapper contract for the shared calendar runtime: surface, event model, playlist models, operation context, selection/state callbacks, and export request.

calendar_component.why: Reusable Blazor wrapper around the calendar runtime with typed callbacks, export hook, and JS interop lifecycle.

calendar_interop.why: Thin bridge between Blazor and the legacy/shared calendar engine. Handles state serialization, typed callback payloads, and JS widget lifecycle.

calendar_js.why: Large specialized calendar widget that already contains its own view renderers, panel, list, editor, export flows, and hit handling. This is a sibling runtime, not a graph scene graph.

project_structure_page.why: Primary graph-editor page for project structure. Wires the shared workbench shell, builds nodes/actions, persists positions and view state, hosts inspector panels, and still contains several canvas-specific policies that should move into shared/domain adapter components.

project_structure_catalog.why: Domain action catalog and label resolver for Project Structure create flows and inspector create groups.

project_workbench_models.why: Domain models and service layer for project structure and project calendar, including persistence of links, node movement, UI state, and graph synchronization.

legacy_structure_component.why: Legacy project structure wrapper that still targets the old workbench JS runtime and should be retired after migration to the shared workbench system.

legacy_project_calendar_component.why: Legacy project calendar wrapper using the old workbench JS runtime. This is the primary migration target for adopting CanvasCalendar.

project_calendar_page.why: Project calendar page that still uses the legacy calendar wrapper and manually parses selected event IDs from JSON view state.

legacy_workbench_js.why: Legacy graph and calendar runtime. Contains older canvas drawing helpers, hit testing, and duplicate calendar wrapper logic that should not continue as the strategic base.

prompt_factory_page.why: Main prompt builder/editor page. Uses the shared workbench shell but still builds graph projection, branch lanes, attachments, and UI-state persistence inline in the page.

prompt_factory_catalog_page.why: Selection graph builder and catalog behavior for the prompt factory canvas.

prompt_factory_canvas_inspector.why: Floating inspector docking logic used by the prompt factory canvas.

prompt_factory_history.why: Prompt Factory undo/redo stack and keyboard shortcut registration. Valuable evidence for shared history and shortcut abstractions.

prompt_factory_catalog.why: Prompt Factory domain create/action catalog used to populate canvas context actions and create menus.

factory_domain.why: Prompt Factory domain models, including run node summaries, attachment summaries, setup profile, and editor state persisted with CanvasUiStateJson.

prompt_factory_service.why: Prompt Factory domain service handling recommendations, state persistence, branching, build/export/send flows, and canvas UI-state persistence.

project_structure_tests.why: Current component tests touching project structure page rendering and action exposure.
symbols: Prompt flow nodes expose Wizard navigation

prompt_factory_tests.why: Current component tests touching prompt factory undo/redo controls and preview modal behavior.
symbols: Preview query opens built prompt modal

docs_gap_analysis.why: Existing internal analysis of reference workbench behavior and gaps.

docs_shared_spec.why: Existing shared canvas system specification that already separates Blazor-owned and JS-owned responsibilities.

docs_impl_plan.why: Existing implementation plan for the shared canvas direction. Helpful for sequencing and validating the migration roadmap.
symbols: Phase 1: Build the shared canvas foundation

docs_calendar_plan.why: Existing design note arguing for a full-widget Blazor wrapper around the calendar runtime before deeper rewrite.

docs_missing_components.why: Existing recommendation list that already calls out modal, tooltip, popover, and other shared UI gaps relevant to canvas work.
